display.purpose: Screen titles and the event title over its photograph. One per screen.

headline.purpose: Section headings — Upcoming Events, Trending Now, Choose a ride.

title.purpose: Card titles and list row titles.

label.purpose: Buttons, chips, segmented controls and the See all action. Uppercase is reserved for 10px badges.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Every white card and list row on the paper ground.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Media panels and confirmation panels — the heaviest objects on the screen.

shadows.name: tabbar
shadows.purpose: The fixed bottom navigation and the sticky action bar.

shadows.name: brand
shadows.purpose: The orange glow under a primary button, an active chip and the raised ride button.

shadows.name: brand-lift
shadows.purpose: The round media action inside a hero panel.

motion.name: eq
motion.purpose: The pulse strip's staggered equalizer loop. motion-safe only.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: The single entrance moment, used when a booking is confirmed.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Inline notices, such as the filter count.

motion.name: carousel
motion.purpose: The home hero's slide interval. Suspended while the reader touches the rail and under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a screen wants taken. Deep Signal with a brand glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: #d63f08; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgb(252 83 3 / 0.85); transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c13907; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #a83205; transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc5303; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter alternative: white with a hairline border and black type.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 46px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #e4e0d7; border-radius: 11px; background: #ffffff; color: #14120f; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f1eee7; border-color: #d3cec3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc5303; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Pill
components.description: The two big moves on the ride and track screens — full pills, not rectangles.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 42px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #d63f08; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgb(252 83 3 / 0.85); transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #c13907; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc5303; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filters. The selected chip fills and carries the brand glow.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; margin-right: 6px; border: 1px solid #e4e0d7; border-radius: 9px; background: #ffffff; color: #3c4657; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #d3cec3; } .ds-chip-on { border-color: transparent; background: #d63f08; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px -10px rgb(252 83 3 / 0.85); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc5303; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: List Card
components.description: A white sheet on the paper ground: hairline border, soft offset shadow, 14px radius.
components.html: Sunset Live SessionsLabadi Beach · 1.4 kmfrom GHC120
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #e4e0d7; border-radius: 14px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(23 26 31 / 0.04), 0 10px 24px -16px rgb(23 26 31 / 0.22); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #d3cec3; } .ds-card-thumb { width: 88px; height: 98px; border-radius: 10px; background: #0b0b0d; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-card-body strong { font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: #14120f; } .ds-card-body span { font-size: 12.5px; color: #6c665f; } .ds-card-body em { font-style: normal; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #c33c08; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Search and address fields: white, hairline border, the border is the only focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field > span { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #6c665f; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #e4e0d7; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #14120f; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #6c665f; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(252, 83, 3, 0.5); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status is never colour alone: every badge carries a glyph and a word.
components.html: Confirmed
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e4f5e9; color: #116b39; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; }

components.name: Tab Bar Item
components.description: The phone's bottom bar. Active takes Signal Orange and a heavier stroke.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; color: #3c4657; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab-on { color: #fc5303; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc5303; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ride Button
components.description: The raised centre of the phone's bar: the action the app exists for.
components.css: .ds-ride { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 54px; height: 54px; margin-top: -16px; border-radius: 999px; background: #d63f08; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -12px rgb(252 83 3 / 0.6); ring: 5px solid #f7f5f1; outline: 5px solid #f7f5f1; transition: transform 160ms ease; } .ds-ride:hover { background: #c13907; } .ds-ride:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-ride:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc5303; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pulse Strip
components.description: The brand's only graphic and the system's only animation: a staggered equalizer of brand bars.
components.css: .ds-pulse { display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2.5px; height: 15px; } .ds-pulse i { display: block; width: 3px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fc5303; transform-origin: bottom; animation: ds-eq 1.1s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-eq { 0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.42); } 50% { transform: scaleY(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pulse i { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Flash looks like a piece of good printed paper with one live signal running through it. The ground is warm off-white, the cards are plain white sheets on top of it, the type is black and confident, and the only colour in the whole system is a single broadcast orange. That orange is not decoration: it marks the one thing that is happening right now.

The inherited reference already knew this: one hot orange on warm paper, white date chips, photographic panels with a black scrim, a five-bar waveform as the only graphic. Flash keeps that language and points it at three urban services instead of a radio schedule. The pulse mark survives as the brand's one graphic — five rounded bars, now animated, now the signal that a ticket, a ride or a meal is on its way.

The system is deliberately small. There is one typeface, one accent, one card treatment and one shadow vocabulary. The density is phone-first and generous: 20px gutters, 14px cards, hairline borders, and touch targets that are never smaller than 44px. The desktop is not a stretched phone — it is a re-composition into a left navigation rail, a central column and a right rail, the idiom of a social app.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, white sheets on top of it, one hot orange for anything live.
The five-bar pulse: the brand's only graphic, and the only animated element.
Photography carries the emotion; the type stays black and the chrome stays quiet.
Status is never colour alone — every state carries an icon and a word.
Every surface that shows a price says, once, that the price is demo data.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange appears on the thing that is live — the active tab, the primary button, the route, the pulse — and almost nowhere else. When everything is orange, nothing is.

rules.name: The Deep Signal Rule
rules.body: Any orange fill that carries white text uses Deep Signal (#d63f08), never Signal Orange. The vivid orange is for graphics.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every word in the product is Inter. A second typeface is a new brand decision, not a styling choice.

rules.name: The Heavy Head Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight. There are no eyebrows or kickers above a heading in Flash.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Photography never carries text without a scrim.

dos: Do use Deep Signal (#d63f08) for any orange fill that carries white text, and Ink Orange (#c33c08) for orange text on paper.
Do keep exactly one animated element on a screen, and make it the pulse.
Do put an icon and a word on every status — confirmed, pending, cancelled, on the way.
Do use one photographic panel per screen at full bleed, with a scrim, and let the rest of the page stay flat and quiet.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or larger, and the ride button at 54px.
Do let the desktop re-compose: rail, column, right rail — never a stretched phone frame.
Do say once, quietly, that prices and ratings are demo data on every screen that shows them.
donts: Don't use Signal Orange (#fc5303) as a background behind small white text; it is 3.3:1 and fails AA.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use a hard offset shadow, a glass panel, or gradient text.
Don't use two typefaces, or a second accent colour.
Don't clip a card at the edge of the desktop column — use the grid.
Don't show a rating, price or availability figure without saying it is demo data.
Don't fabricate a satellite map, a real receipt or a real rating count.
